description: Walk the knowledge graph from one entity in a single call. start: an entity @id or a name (resolved like fuzzy_find_and_traverse). path: one entry per hop, each a predicate or a list of predicates; prefix a predicate with ^ to follow it backwards (e.g. ^worksFor finds who works for an organisation). Literal values (dates, names, emails) named in a hop are returned in values. Example, who founded the company Hamza works for and when: start "Hamza Ashraf", path [["worksFor"], ["founder", "foundingDate"]]. Without path, follows every link for maxHops (1-3, default 2) and returns links only, with a budget of 100 rows shared between hops, so hubs are cut short rather than hiding later hops (use a path to go deeper: a path call may return up to 400 rows). Returns edges [{hop, from, predicate, to, to_name, to_types}], values [{hop, subject, subject_name, predicate, value}], truncated and truncated_hops (the hops that hit a limit).
name: traverse_path
